objects=data['objects']
print(type(objects))
print([(ob.keys() if isinstance(ob,dict) else type(ob)) for ob in objects[:1]])
print(str(objects[7])[:2500])
f=render_local('SCENE',[3.5,-3.5,1.0],2.6,include_image=False)
print(f)

ob=next(ob for ob in objects if ob['name']=='Obj_08')
verts=np.array(ob['vertices']); tris=np.array(ob['triangles'])
frames={}
for name in ['SCENE','TOP','LEFT','RIGHT','FRONT','BACK']:
    frame=f if name=='SCENE' else render_local(name,[3.5,-3.5,1.0],2.6,include_image=False)
    frames[name]=frame
    buf=buffers[frame['ref']]
    if name=='SCENE': print('buffer keys',buf.keys())
    ids=np.asarray(buf['triangle_ids']); owners=np.asarray(buf['owners'])
    offset=frame['source_face_offsets'][frame['object_names'].index('Obj_08')]
    samples=[]
    for tri in [0,1,8,9]:
        pixels=np.argwhere((ids==offset+tri)&(owners==frame['object_names'].index('Obj_08')))
        record={'triangle':tri,'pixels':len(pixels)}
        if len(pixels):
            row,col=pixels[len(pixels)//2]
            vm=np.array(frame['pose']['view_matrix'])
            corners=verts[tris[tri]]
            cam=np.c_[corners,np.ones(3)]@vm.T
            xy=(cam[:,:2]/(2.6/2)+1)*255.5
            xy[:,1]=511-xy[:,1]
            bary=np.linalg.solve(np.vstack([xy.T,np.ones(3)]),[col+0.5,row+0.5,1])
            record.update(pixel_rc=[int(row),int(col)],world_m=(bary@corners).round(9).tolist())
        samples.append(record)
    print(name,samples)
print('selected triangle vertices', {int(idx):verts[tris[idx]].tolist() for idx in [0,1,8,9]})
